import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('don_hang.csv')
ct = pd.read_csv('chi_tiet_don.csv')

print("Status values:", df['Tình trạng'].unique())
print("Date format sample:", df['Ngày'].dtype, df['Ngày'].iloc[0])

# December 2025
mask = (df['Ngày'] >= '2025-12-01') & (df['Ngày'] <= '2025-12-31')
dec = df[mask].copy()
print("Rows in Dec 2025:", len(dec))
print("Status counts in Dec:", dec['Tình trạng'].value_counts().to_dict())

# Revenue orders: not cancelled, not returned. completed + shipping included.
keep = ['completed', 'shipping']
dec_keep = dec[dec['Tình trạng'].isin(keep)].copy()
print("Keep status counts:", dec_keep['Tình trạng'].value_counts().to_dict())

# Join line items, sum Amount per day
ct['Mã đơn hàng'] = ct['Mã đơn hàng'].astype(str)
dec_keep['Mã chứng từ'] = dec_keep['Mã chứng từ'].astype(str)
joined = dec_keep.merge(ct, left_on='Mã chứng từ', right_on='Mã đơn hàng', how='left')
print("Joined rows:", len(joined))
print("Null Amount after join:", joined['Amount'].isna().sum())

daily = joined.groupby('Ngày')['Amount'].sum()
daily = daily.sort_values(ascending=False)
print("\nTop 5 days by revenue:")
print(daily.head())
print("\nAll days:")
print(daily)
